title: Price the incentive with its obligations
displayTitle: Price the incentive with its obligations
seoTitle: Texas JETI Incentives 2026: Eligibility, Tax Savings & Project Risk
subtitle: A school-tax value limitation can improve a Texas investment. The return depends on the property covered, the signed timetable, and the operating commitments that survive the incentive period.
seoDescription: Texas JETI research for site-selection and finance teams: eligible property, school M&O tax limits, jobs, wages, competitive-site evidence and a worked return model.
author: Sulayman Bowles
evidenceBoundary: Texas Government Code Subchapter T and official program documents checked October 12, 2026. Published application and reporting records are evidence of those documents, not an independent audit of operating output, employment or investment. All return calculations use declared hypothetical inputs. Actual project eligibility, agreements, tax treatment and compliance require professional review.
content: A Texas incentive can be described as a 50 percent limitation without cutting a project's total property-tax bill in half. JETI limits the taxable value of eligible property for a school district's maintenance-and-operations tax. It does not automatically reduce school debt-service taxes, county or city taxes, every asset at the site, or the project's construction cost. The first underwriting task is to locate the benefit in the actual tax stack. [Government Code §403.605](#source-code)

The Jobs, Energy, Technology and Innovation program connects a company, school district and governor through an agreement with investment, employment, wage and other requirements. Current public records now include both signed agreements and 2026 reporting documents. For a business choosing a site or a supplier assessing a proposed plant, those are different stages of evidence. [Program overview](#source-overview) · [Current agreements](#source-agreements)

A financeable decision needs more than a projected incentive total. It needs eligible property, a credible competing-location process, an executable construction schedule, the signed agreement and an owner for continuing obligations. Put those alongside power, water, hiring and customer qualification. A tax benefit improves the economics of an operating project; it cannot by itself make that project deliver usable capacity.

sections.title: Find the tax that is actually reduced
paragraphs: During the incentive period, §403.605 sets eligible property's school M&O taxable value at 50 percent of its annual market value, or 25 percent when the property qualifies for the opportunity-zone treatment. That second figure is a 75 percent reduction in the relevant value, rather than a 75 percent discount on the whole site's tax bill. Separate the two percentages in the model. [§403.605(a)](#source-code)

The statute also provides zero M&O taxable value for eligible property during the specified construction years, starting with the tax year after the agreement year and ending with the year containing construction completion. The incentive and construction periods are part of the agreement. Do not replace those dates with an assumption that the discount begins when a board approves the project. [§403.605(b); §403.612](#source-code)

Use separate lines for eligible value, excluded assets, school M&O, school interest-and-sinking taxes, and the other taxing units. Model depreciation or reappraisal and actual adopted rates year by year. An incentive measured as a percentage of market value creates a different cash path from a fixed-dollar grant, especially when equipment value falls or school rates change.

Ask the appraisal and tax advisers to reconcile the agreement's property schedule with the proposed fixed-asset register. A headquarters, old equipment, inventory and land should not enter the discounted-value cell by proximity to an eligible production building. Keep the ordinary business-property-tax forecast available so the team can see exactly which line the incentive changes.

sections.title: Eligibility is an activity, property and timing question
paragraphs: The current statutory definition includes specified manufacturing, utility, natural-resource, high-technology and critical-infrastructure projects, and excludes nondispatchable generation and energy-storage facilities. An industry label is only an initial screen. Match the actual activity and applicable classification to current agency requirements before relying on a proposed benefit. [§403.602(8)](#source-code) · [Program guidance](#source-overview)

Eligible property has its own boundary: the statute specifies qualifying new buildings or expansions constructed after agreement execution and qualifying tangible property first located in the relevant zone after that date, with ownership or capitalized-lease conditions. Investment excludes land and inventory. Buying a site early or assigning equipment to an existing operation can therefore affect the eligible package even when total capital spending is large. [§403.602(9), (13)](#source-code) · [Official FAQ](#source-faq)

Jobs and minimum investment depend on county population; for a project crossing counties, the statutory requirement uses the smallest-population county in which part of the project lies. The minimums are not the applicant's entire operating plan. They establish a program screen and continuing commitments, while demand, safe staffing and supplier needs determine the viable business. [§403.604](#source-code)

The required investment and initial jobs are due by the end of the first tax year of the incentive period, and the statutory jobs requirement continues through agreement expiry. An eligible dispatchable-generation project has a separate jobs exception. Apply that exception only to the category it covers; it is not an exemption for every capital-intensive operation. [§403.604(a), (b)](#source-code)

sections.title: Retain the competing-site evidence before the decision closes
paragraphs: The Comptroller's FAQ says a positive recommendation needs a current competitive site-selection process with tangible planning for locations outside Texas. Examples include detailed incentive letters, shareholder presentations comparing locations and internal fiscal comparisons. Showing that an incentive improves project viability is insufficient by itself. That makes the evidence task relevant before the company has effectively committed to one site. [Compelling-factor FAQ](#source-faq)

A useful location memo compares the same operating project across plausible sites. Retain the dated alternatives, access to power and water, logistics, labor, permits, customer requirements and total expected cash cost. Record which assumptions are signed commitments and which remain estimates. The tax adviser can then connect the commercial decision to the agency's actual criteria.

The official process begins with a complete application and proof of the $30,000 school-district application fee. Its timeline distinguishes the Comptroller's recommendation, favorable governor and school-district determinations, a public hearing and execution of the agreement. It also identifies a performance bond. Those steps belong on the critical path and in transaction costs. [Process and timeline](#source-process)

The published agency timeline is a process guide. Check the current statute and the actual correspondence before treating a stated review period as a guaranteed closing date. Administrative completeness, amendments, questions and the district's hearing schedule can change the business's timetable. An unsigned favorable letter should not be booked as a completed agreement.

sections.title: Read applications, agreements and reports as separate evidence
paragraphs: The J0013 public record for Brazos Midland Processing in Stanton ISD illustrates the document sequence. The application was posted December 23, 2024, an agreement was posted August 11, 2025, and a 2026 biennial report was posted September 16, 2026. Those are posting dates, not interchangeable dates of expenditure, signing or production. [Official project record](#source-project)

The 2026 report identifies July 29, 2025 as the agreement-execution date and a 2026–2035 incentive period, followed by a 2038 final maintain-viable-presence year. Its presence shows why ongoing reporting belongs in the diligence package. It does not establish from the listing alone that every obligation was fulfilled or that output is available to a buyer today. [2026 report, first page](#source-report)

For a proposed manufacturing supplier, trace the same sequence and add commissioning, product qualification and customer delivery evidence. For a lender or buyer of the project company, obtain the signed agreement, amendments, compliance correspondence and the liabilities that transfer. Publicly proposed investment should remain labeled as proposed when it enters an opportunity model.

Avoid adding every application amount into a headline for realized Texas investment. A proposed amount, current-agreement listing and reported spending have different definitions and observation dates. The commercial value of the public record is that it helps identify the next document to request, rather than eliminate the need for project-level verification.

sections.title: Calculate the benefit after the obligations
paragraphs: Consider a hypothetical eligible $300 million property value, held constant solely to explain the arithmetic. Assume an M&O rate of $0.60 per $100, a school debt-service rate of $0.25, and other local rates totaling $1.10. The unassisted annual bill on that assumed value is $5.85 million. Real assets, rates and valuation paths would need separate projections.

A normal 50 percent M&O value limitation reduces the assumed M&O tax from $1.8 million to $900,000. The other $4.05 million of taxes remain in this simplified model, making total annual tax $4.95 million. The annual savings are $900,000, or about 15.4 percent of the full unassisted bill. Applying a 50 percent discount to $5.85 million would materially overstate the benefit.

If the same assumed eligible value satisfied the opportunity-zone treatment, M&O tax would be $450,000 and the total bill $4.5 million, a $1.35 million annual reduction. Eligibility and the property's zone boundary must be demonstrated independently. This is a comparison of statutory mechanics using declared inputs, not a recommendation for a particular location.

For the normal limitation, ten level annual savings of $900,000 discounted at an assumed 8 percent have a present value of approximately $6.04 million. Assume, separately, $150,000 of incremental annual program-related cost during those ten years and $250,000 upfront. The simplified net present value falls to approximately $4.78 million. This estimate excludes construction-period benefits, changing rates and values, financing effects, taxes on income, post-incentive obligations and downside liabilities.

The actual investment decision should replace every assumed cost with the agreed requirement or a defensible operating estimate. Include bond cost, administration, any incremental wage or staffing cost, recordkeeping, and obligations after the discount stops. Evaluate a delay scenario: postponed production can consume more value than an attractive annual tax saving produces.

sections.title: The compliance tail can outlast the savings
paragraphs: The agreement specifies employment and investment obligations, a wage requirement and health-benefit provisions. The statutory wage test requires the relevant average to exceed 110 percent of the applicable industry-sector average computed by TWC using the most recent available four quarters. Count qualifying jobs and the appropriate payroll, rather than assume any announced construction headcount satisfies the agreement. [§403.612(b)](#source-code) The full-time definition requires at least 1,600 hours annually and excludes construction jobs. Transferring an existing Texas job generally requires filling the resulting vacancy. Test the staffing plan against those definitions before counting the promised positions. [§403.602(10); §403.604(c)](#source-code)

The law provides penalties for specified jobs or wage failures across two consecutive reports, subject to the statutory tax-benefit cap. It separately allows termination after notice and a 180-day cure-and-dispute period, with a penalty equal to lost ad valorem revenue plus interest if termination occurs under that provision. Those are distinct mechanisms; a general statement that there is a cure period should not erase the modeled downside. [§403.614; §403.612(d)](#source-code)

Assign the obligation register to an accountable finance owner with operating, HR and legal support. It should show each deadline, definition, data source, evidence file, certification and escalation route. Keep the construction workforce separate from required permanent jobs and reconcile contractors against the actual agreement and reporting instructions.

The official process includes a three-year maintain-viable-presence period after the incentive period. An exit model should therefore address sale, closure, refinancing and assignment during that tail. The proposed selling price should not assume the incentive can be transferred with no consent, ongoing requirement or liability review. [Program timeline](#source-process)

sections.title: Make one investment memo carry the benefit and the risk
paragraphs: Present the operating case without the incentive first, then show the exact tax lines changed by the signed program. That makes the project's dependence on approval, schedule and compliance visible to the investment committee. Resolve site authority and capacity alongside the tax analysis, rather than after an incentive announcement has created pressure to proceed.

Recheck this research when program rules, eligibility, the property boundary, adopted rates, agreement terms or reporting outcomes change. For a live project, the controlling evidence is its current signed package and official correspondence. A general program article provides the questions and mechanisms; it does not certify that project's benefit.
bullets: Which activity, assets and dates meet current eligibility and zone requirements?
What dated evidence demonstrates a genuine competing-site process?
Which tax lines change, when does each benefit begin, and what costs offset it?
Who owns jobs, wages, investment, bond and continuing-report obligations?
What does delay, sale, closure or a compliance failure do to the project's cash and exit value?

conclusion.title: Underwrite the agreement as part of the project
conclusion.content: JETI is most useful when the business can identify the benefit precisely and operate the commitments that support it. Model the school M&O reduction, prove the competitive-site case, retain the signed schedule and price the compliance tail. That produces an incentive analysis the next lender, buyer or operating owner can inspect.

faqs.question: Does JETI cut all Texas property taxes by 50 percent?
faqs.answer: No. The normal limitation makes eligible property's school M&O taxable value 50 percent of market value during the incentive period. School debt service and other taxing units are separate. Qualifying opportunity-zone property has a different M&O value limit. [§403.605](#source-code)

faqs.question: Do land and inventory count toward JETI investment?
faqs.answer: The statutory investment definition excludes land and inventory. Eligible buildings and tangible property also have ownership, zone and post-agreement timing requirements. Match the actual assets to the current definition. [§403.602](#source-code) · [FAQ](#source-faq)

faqs.question: Is a better project return enough to prove JETI is a compelling factor?
faqs.answer: The Comptroller's FAQ says financial viability alone is insufficient. It requires current competing-site evidence and tangible planning for sites outside Texas, such as incentive letters or internal location comparisons. [Official compelling-factor guidance](#source-faq)

faqs.question: Do JETI obligations end when the incentive period ends?
faqs.answer: Some continue. The official timeline includes three years of maintain-viable-presence after the incentive period, and the agreement defines continuing requirements. Review the signed package before modeling an exit or closure. [Process and timeline](#source-process) · [§403.612](#source-code)
